definitions.full: H6353. pechar מֶּחָר noun masculine potter ( = pa——âr , מַּחָר ᵑ7 (also clay ), Syriac ; probably loan-word from Assyrian pa—aru , potter , compare Brock Zim Buhl ); — absolute ׳פ Dan 2:41 .
